C27_to_EN.shared_lead_qualification: The lead starts inside C27 positive copper. VIN and EN split at cap_via immediately beyond the south paste edge; EN inner copper is a leaf and cannot carry any other load current.

C31_to_VIN.qualification: Declared full pad-center/track-axis witness. Pad spreading and barrels excluded from resistance. Both capacitors share the C27-star-to-VIN path; the capacitance sum does not establish high-frequency local equivalence.

after_axis.qualification: Specific continuous path witness, not a solved plane-current path. Pad spreading resistance is not modeled. Filled B/In4 return copper can carry current in parallel.

C31.2.plane_requirement: C31 has no track/pad/via-only path to U14 ground. Its dedicated .250 B lead reaches the relocated ground through-via. Source B.Cu component0 and continuous In1/In4 components provide finite contact witnesses, but new fill must prove the same attachments and neck widths.

shared_impedance.C27_and_C31: Both capacitors supply VIN through the same .250 mm outer cap-star/VIN path. C31 additionally uses its 1.554858 mm B lead, the repaired .250 B source branch, and the existing C27 positive feed. The local EN leaf shares the cap-positive lead and star via, not its thin inner return branch.
shared_impedance.upstream_distribution: U10.IN and C18.1 retain the complete upstream west-escape distribution. U14.6 and U14.7 no longer attach at the old local west junction. Protected D5/D6 cathode paths remain; no diode bypass or switch/output change is introduced.

C18_to_U10.qualification: Inherited complete upstream path plus frozen west transaction; remains a separate LDO input-decoupling/layout review, not covered by the TPS629210 CIN qualification.

device_and_engineering_gates.requirements: TPS629210 Rev B section7.3 requires >=3 microfarads effective input capacitance; section11.1 requires short wide switched-current paths, input capacitance close to VIN/GND, a small input loop, and VIN-tied EN connected directly at the input capacitor.
device_and_engineering_gates.capacitance: Effective CIN qualification of the approved capacitor pair is separate evidence; DC-bias sum alone does not prove local HF effectiveness.
device_and_engineering_gates.routing_tradeoff: C27 positive routing remains a 9.401063 mm B/F/B centerline detour with two through-via transitions. This is shorter and lower nominal trace resistance than inherited r61 routing, but is not the ideal minimum-area local capacitor loop; source reference-plane continuity and finite local returns need native review. C31 is farther and shares the same VIN feed. No universal length threshold or current rating is claimed.
native_requirements: Atomic application of all tracks, vias and approved footprint changes; preserve repaired r61 via519792ac and donors32268524/8a1c0c54.
Refill, full DRC, unconnected-item report and exact emitted copper/mask/paste inspection in the sole native lane.
